problem: The configuration toggle is understandable only after reading a long label, while the disclosed workbench opens on the opposite edge and separates the selected configuration from its edit/run actions.
scope: task-page disclosure control, left/right workbench geometry, selected-file action placement, responsive layout, keyboard access, and terminal presentation copy
baseline: A left navigation action named 运行配置 opens a 48vw panel on the right; edit and icon-only run actions sit at the far edge of a wide workbench header; xterm receives synthetic connection lines.
benchmarks: WAI-ARIA disclosure button with synchronized aria-expanded and aria-controls
VS Code primary sidebar view container with short names and contextual view-title actions
Material supplementary side sheet and persistent drawer patterns
xterm as a renderer of process byte streams with surrounding state owned by application chrome
advantages: The existing semantic button, state persistence, resource tree, Monaco editor, xterm and mature addons can be retained
The config workbench is already one cohesive component
Server and plugin contracts do not depend on panel placement
disadvantages: The control label duplicates the already-understood task context
The panel expands from the right despite its trigger living on the left
An icon-only run action is less explicit than the secondary edit action
Synthetic connection copy pollutes searchable terminal history
limitations: A persistent side-by-side panel is viable only at wide widths
Phone layouts must stack rather than compress a resource tree and editor side by side
No new component runtime is justified unless native semantic controls cannot meet the measured interaction contract
defects: disclosure direction and panel edge disagree
frequent selected-object actions are visually remote and asymmetric
terminal presentation state is written into the emulated byte stream
bottlenecks: visual geometry must be checked in real browsers at three widths
configuration resource and edit/run states must remain preserved during disclosure
fixed legacy browsers constrain CSS and JavaScript choices

metrics.name: configuration discoverability
metrics.threshold: button text 配置 plus directional state indicator in both states

metrics.name: wide-screen ownership geometry
metrics.threshold: configuration panel left edge precedes task pane left edge and page overflow equals zero

metrics.name: selected-config primary actions
metrics.threshold: zero menu or navigation operations before edit or run
metrics.measurement: rendered pointer and keyboard task paths

metrics.name: synthetic terminal lines
metrics.measurement: xterm write spy and browser terminal text

hypotheses: A left primary workbench aligned with its disclosure control forms a clearer spatial model than a right secondary panel
A compact labeled action cluster beside the selected configuration reduces ambiguity without adding a mode menu
Connection and read-only state belong in the terminal header, never in the byte buffer
allowed_variables: task workspace grid areas and borders
configuration disclosure label and directional icon

stages.input: current rendered task and terminal pages
stages.output: tests that reject right-side configuration, remote/ambiguous actions and synthetic terminal lines
left configuration workbench and responsive stack

stages.input: selected config state and process byte stream
stages.output: nearby explicit edit/run actions and unpolluted terminal history
stages.checker: pointer/keyboard flows and xterm write spy
stages.rollback: workbench header or terminal presentation owner

hard_gates: known right-side baseline is rejected and left-side success fixture is accepted
configuration state survives close and reopen
edit and run remain direct actions with accessible names
no connection or read-only UI status is appended to xterm
1440px, intermediate and 390px layouts have zero page overflow
failure_fixtures: configuration panel bounding box lies to the right of task pane
toggle says 运行配置 and uses a right-opening icon for a left owner
run is icon-only while edit is text and both sit at the remote header edge
terminal buffer begins with bracketed connection prose
success_fixtures: 配置 disclosure opens a left-side primary workbench
selected configuration has an adjacent compact 编辑/运行 action cluster
narrow layout stacks configuration before tasks without overflow
terminal buffer contains only bytes read from the task log/WebSocket
fault_injections: swap grid areas back to tasks then run
replace the run label with an icon-only button
rollback: Return to the earliest failing oracle, layout, action, or terminal owner and invalidate dependent browser evidence.

iteration_budget.review_trigger: second failure of the same ownership model or any legacy-browser regression

stop_conditions: failure baseline rejected and current UI accepted
all interaction, accessibility, responsive and resource gates pass
project and user-root Skill writebacks validate
exact release artifact passes browser and consumer gates

promotion_decision.reason: Spatially aligned disclosure, contextual actions and terminal stream purity recur across operator consoles.

writeback: Keep LocalFlow-specific geometry in the project Skill and add the generic terminal-stream anti-pattern plus aligned primary-sidebar rule to the user-root modern web interface references.
